name: Article 14, § 3 – 145
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: 3. In drawing their conclusions concerning effective implementation of the relevant conventions, the Commission and, where appropriate, the European External Action Service shall assess the conclusions and recommendations of the relevant monitoring bodies, as well as, without prejudice to other sources, information submitted by the European Parliament or the Council and by governments or international organisations. Information submitted by private actors, including civil society organisations and social partners, may be taken into account where it is accurate and reliable but shall not create any special complaint, control or co-decision rights.
